name: East Chicago (United States)
description: White field quartered by a wide blue vertical bar for the Indiana Harbor Ship Canal, with red and white crosses bottony for the Jesuit explorers in the upper hoist and lower fly and yellow beehives with bees in the other quarters.
history: East Chicago is a city in Lake County, Indiana, incorporated in 1893. The city's own description quoted on Flags of the World reads the crosses as the Jesuit explorers Marquette, Jolliet and La Salle, the beehives as industry and the blue band as the Indiana Harbor Ship Canal.

features.role: wide vertical bar for the Indiana Harbor Ship Canal
crosses bottony counterchanged red and white, after the Maryland flag
beehives with bees in the upper fly and lower hoist
